title: Create .agent/ directory as part of scaffold
description: After copying template files, scaffold.ts must create the .agent/ directory structure in the new project. This includes all subdirectories, placeholder files, and an empty tasks.json.

steps.details: Import the createAgentStructure function from src/lib/agent-init.ts: `import { createAgentStructure } from './agent-init.js'`. Call it after processTemplate: `await createAgentStructure(destPath)`.
After scaffolding a test project to a temp directory, run `find /tmp/test-project/.agent -type f` and confirm all expected files are present.

technicalNotes: createAgentStructure is implemented in TASK-83 — this task only wires it into scaffold.ts
The .agent/ directory should be created AFTER the template files are copied to avoid conflicts
